messages:
alex: quick handoff — rolling out backend v5.2 tonight 21:30 UTC. Primary risk: KV cache key format change (minor schema change) could surface increased 500s if backfill hits hot keys. Freeze window 21:15–22:00 UTC. If error rate > 0.5% or p95 latency > 300ms abort and revert. Watchers: @mira @sam. Leaving notes in runbook link below.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: service=backend env=prod start=21:30UTC canary=2 pods watch=15m auto-promote=false :rocket:

mira: I'll take primary watch. I'll run the canary smoke at ~21:45 and monitor error rate / traces. tagging @julie for rollback ops.

sam: quick ask — can we add a kv-version check to the smoke? if yes, I'll paste a one-liner to use in the watcher runbook.

sam: ```
# smoke check for kv-version header
curl -sS -D - https://backend.internal/health | grep 'kv-version: 5.2'
```

julie: rollback plan: if we need to abort -> pin to image redwood/backend:5.1 and restart pods. also run the cache-backfill job in read-only mode to undo key mutations if needed. commands: `kubectl set image deploy/backend backend=redwood/backend:5.1 && kubectl rollout restart deploy/backend`

alex: added the above to the handoff doc: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-format-migration (runbook has exact rollback snippets + who-to-pager). Pager if emergency: eng-oncall paging policy.

sam: I'll push a tiny smoke script to the repo and post link in thread. planning to include both health + kv-version check + a simple sample call.

mira: noted. escalation path: if infra spikes or sustained p50 > 200ms for 10m escalate to #eng-sre and call the oncall number. :rotating_light:

deploy-bot: canary rollout started 21:31UTC · 2/2 canary pods up · health checks passing

julie: ack. I'll standby to execute rollback if asked. ping me on DM for immediate action.

alex: leaving now — thanks team. I'll be reachable for 30m by DM. :thumbsup:

mira: thanks — taking over watch. will post canary smoke results here at ~21:45.

sam: thanks all, will post smoke script link in 10m.
